trophies.name: Cap It All Off!
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.

trophies.name: New Cap, New Journey
trophies.description: Team up with Cappy and set sail from the Cap Kingdom.

trophies.name: Dino Might
trophies.description: Defeat Madame Broode and claim the Multi-Moon in the Cascade Kingdom.

trophies.name: Sands of Time
trophies.description: Topple Knucklotec and claim the Multi-Moon in the Sand Kingdom.

trophies.name: Gone Fishing
trophies.description: Plumb the depths and claim the Multi-Moon in the Lake Kingdom.

trophies.name: Timber!
trophies.description: Defeat the Ruined Dragon and claim the Multi-Moon in the Wooded Kingdom.

trophies.name: Lava Me Alone
trophies.description: Outrun Hariet's molten chase and claim the Multi-Moon in the Lost Kingdom.

trophies.name: City That Never Jumps
trophies.description: Defeat the Mechawiggler and claim the Multi-Moon in the Metro Kingdom.

trophies.name: Cold Front
trophies.description: Complete the Shiverian trials and claim the Multi-Moon in the Snow Kingdom.

trophies.name: Shell We Dance?
trophies.description: Uncover the secrets of Bubblaine and claim the Multi-Moon in the Seaside Kingdom.

trophies.name: Extra Spicy
trophies.description: Cross the boiling lake and claim the Multi-Moon in the Luncheon Kingdom.

trophies.name: First Blood
trophies.description: Face Bowser for the first time in the Ruined Kingdom.

trophies.name: Bowser's Big Day
trophies.description: Crash the wedding preparations and claim the Multi-Moon in Bowser's Kingdom.

trophies.name: Til Death Do Us Part
trophies.description: Defeat Bowser once and for all and rescue Peach on the Moon.

trophies.name: Home Sweet Home
trophies.description: Reach the credits and unlock the Mushroom Kingdom.

trophies.name: To the Dark Side
trophies.description: Collect 250 Power Moons and unlock the Dark Side.

trophies.name: Into the Darker Side
trophies.description: Reach the Darker Side, the game's ultimate platforming gauntlet.

trophies.name: Hare-Raising
trophies.description: Reach the summit of Rabbit Ridge in the Darker Side.

trophies.name: One Small Jump
trophies.description: Collect your first Power Moon.

trophies.name: Moonstruck
trophies.description: Collect 100 Power Moons.

trophies.name: Lunar Landlord
trophies.description: Collect 500 Power Moons.

trophies.name: Over the Moon
trophies.description: Collect all 880 Power Moons.

trophies.name: Three's a Charm
trophies.description: Collect three Moon Shards to form a complete Power Moon.

trophies.name: Pocket Change
trophies.description: Collect at least one unique Regional Coin souvenir from every Kingdom's gift shop.

trophies.name: Rawr Power
trophies.description: Capture a Tyrannosaurus in the Cascade Kingdom.

trophies.name: Locked On
trophies.description: Capture a Bullet Bill and cruise through the sky.

trophies.name: Good Boy
trophies.description: Capture a Chain Chomp and drag it around by its chain.

trophies.name: Pot Luck
trophies.description: Capture an Uproot and stretch to new heights in the Wooded Kingdom.

trophies.name: Leap of Faith
trophies.description: Capture a Frog and use its jump to reach new heights.

trophies.name: Toxic Bloom
trophies.description: Capture a Poison Piranha Plant and spit your way through acid.

trophies.name: Shell Shocked
trophies.description: Capture a Koopa Troopa and swim using its shell.

trophies.name: Cappy's Little Helpers
trophies.description: Capture every possible enemy and object at least once.

trophies.name: New Look
trophies.description: Purchase your first outfit from a Crazy Cap shop.

trophies.name: Something Blue
trophies.description: Purchase the Wedding Outfit and matching top hat.

trophies.name: Fashionably Late
trophies.description: Purchase every outfit and headwear available across all Crazy Cap shops.

trophies.name: Two Heads Are Better
trophies.description: Defeat a boss with a second player controlling Cappy in 2-Player Assist Mode.

trophies.name: Master of Disguise
trophies.description: Hide successfully in a Luigi's Balloon World hide-and-seek balloon.

trophies.name: Seek and You Shall Find
trophies.description: Find a hidden balloon before time runs out in Luigi's Balloon World.

trophies.name: Record Breaker
trophies.description: Beat a Luigi's Balloon World seeking course in under 10 seconds.

trophies.name: Jump Up, Super Star!
trophies.description: Watch the New Donk City Festival concert for the first time.

trophies.name: Ride or Die
trophies.description: Complete a Jaxi race in the Sand Kingdom.

trophies.name: Where's Peach?
trophies.description: Spot Peach sightseeing in a Kingdom after the credits.

trophies.name: Jump-Rope Champion
trophies.description: Win a jump-rope contest against Pauline in the Metro Kingdom.

trophies.name: Art Appreciation
trophies.description: Use a Hint Toad's photo to uncover a hidden Power Moon.

trophies.name: Untouchable
trophies.description: Defeat a Kingdom boss without taking any damage.

trophies.name: Extra Life
trophies.description: Find a Life-Up Heart to increase your maximum health.
